text: Coffee with Eilidh. Her dad's hip op is booked for May 14 and she's taking the week off to look after him. She's pretty anxious about it tbh. Text her the night before.

Long call with Anders. He got made redundant on Friday, whole team cut. Seems weirdly upbeat, already talking about retraining as an electrician. His wife Marisol is back at work full time now so money's ok for a bit. He's got a meeting with a careers advisor on May 9 and an open day at the college sometime in early June. Remind me to ask Anders how the open day goes, and send him that apprenticeship link.

spans.text: ask Anders how the open day goes

text: Noah starts at the council sometime next week, finally out of retail. Finn said he's nervous about the commute more than the job. Ask Noah how the first day went.

spans.text: Ask Noah how the first day went

text: Lunch w Pooja and Kavya. Pooja's leaving drinks are June 3rd, she's off to a startup in Leeds. Kavya got promoted to team lead last month and is already shattered. I'm bringing the cake for Pooja's do.

spans.text: off to a startup in Leeds

text: Ayo's grandmother passed away on Sunday. Funeral is end of the month, probably in Lagos so he'll fly out. He was close to her. Must call him this weekend, not just text. His wife Efua said he hasn't been sleeping and his boss is being funny about the time off, which is the last thing he needs. Their kids are staying with her mum while he's away.
Bumped into Delroy at the station. Retiring in early March after 31 years at the depot!! Wants to do the coast-to-coast walk over the summer. Need to chip in for his card when it goes round.
Magda and Aleksander have split up. She's staying in the flat, he's moved back to his mum's. Magda said she's fine but didn't seem it. Don't mention it to Zoe yet.
Efua had her gallbladder out on 5/14, home now but can't lift anything for six weeks. Her sister Jasmine is staying with her. She's bored stiff and binging bake off. Maybe drop round some magazines.
Quick catch up with Julien after 5 a side. New job at the hospital trust in finance, starts Oct 3rd. His partner Tanvi is expecting in the spring as well so big year for them.

spans.text: New job at the hospital trust

text: Akira's cat Biscuit had to have a tooth out, poor thing. Akira was more stressed than the cat. Also he's interviewing for a senior role at Nakamura & Chen sometime next week.

spans.text: interviewing for a senior role at Nakamura & Chen

text: Called Barbara. Her knee replacement got postponed again, now maybe end of November. She's fed up and in a lot of pain. I should ring her again Thursday. Her daughter Amy is trying to get her seen privately but the waiting list there is three months too. Barbara's still insisting on doing her own shopping, stubborn as ever. Maybe offer to take her to the big Tesco on Saturday.

spans.text: insisting on doing her own shopping
offer to take her to the big Tesco

text: Ebony's first week as a paramedic. She says the night shifts are brutal but she loves it. Her boyfriend Cem has been doing all the cooking. She's vegan now btw, remember for dinner.
Joseph's mum died last month, I only found out today from Divya. Funeral already happened. Feel awful. Send him a card and a proper message.

spans.text: Send him a card and a proper message

text: Tomás got the promotion to head chef!! Starts officially June 1. Elif says he's been working like 70 hour weeks to get it. Remind me to send congrats to Tomás.
Amy and Patrick were meant to be getting married in August but it's off. They broke up in the spring apparently, Amy only just told people. She's moved in with her brother Lachlan for now.
Aneesh had his scan results back, all clear. He'd been worrying about it for weeks. Celebrating with a curry Saturday, I'm going.
Vanessa's last day at the school is end of the month, she's retiring after teaching for 35 years. Zoe is organising something. Ask Zoe what she needs from me.

spans.text: Ask Zoe what she needs from me

text: Pick up prescription, return library books, sort car tax before the 30th.
Abebe is in hospital with pneumonia, admitted Tuesday. His wife says he should be out sometime next week if the antibiotics work. Remind me to text her for an update on Friday.
Talked to Marisol about her new job at the vet practice. Loves it, much better than the call centre. Her dog Pepper gets to come in on Saturdays. She hates the early starts though.
Lachlan's dad is having bypass surgery on April 22. Lachlan's going up to Inverness for a fortnight to help out. He's putting a brave face on.

Drinks with Finn, Noah and Eilidh. Finn's been offered a job in Berlin, deciding by the end of the month. Noah thinks he should go. Eilidh just finished her nursing course and starts on the wards in early March. Need to get Eilidh a little something for passing.

spans.text: by the end of the month
get Eilidh a little something for passing

text: Kavya mentioned her uncle got laid off from the factory, the whole site is closing. Her family is pretty shaken. She wants to help him with his CV.
Divya's first day at the law firm went ok, bit overwhelming. Her manager seems nice. She's doing a part time masters on top which sounds mad.

spans.text: first day at the law firm

text: Me: dentist 9/12 at 10am, then the job interview at Barros & Lopez on 9/15. Need to iron the blue shirt.
Delroy's wife Jasmine had a fall and broke her wrist last week. Surgery was Monday, she's in a cast now. Delroy is doing all the driving. Should pop round with dinner sometime this week.
Zoe's leaving the agency, last day June 20th. Going freelance. She's nervous about money but excited. Her husband Patrick is fully behind it. Ask her if she wants intros to anyone.

spans.text: Ask her if she wants intros to anyone

text: Elif is having IVF, first round starts sometime next month. Really private about it, said only me and her sister know. She's scared it won't work. Check in with her gently in a couple of weeks.
Joseph told me Abebe's retiring at Christmas. Abebe wants a quiet do, no speeches. He's into fly fishing, apparently dropping hints about a new reel. Could go in on that with Joseph.

spans.text: wants a quiet do, no speeches
dropping hints about a new reel
go in on that with Joseph

text: Tanvi's grandad passed away overnight. She's flying to Delhi on Thursday for the cremation, back around the 12th. Message her before she goes.
Akira didn't get the senior role. He's gutted. Still at the old place for now. Remind me to take him for a pint next week.
Aleksander has started at the warehouse, nights. Says it's fine, the money is good. Still not over Magda I think. He's into climbing again which is good.

Marisol's mum had a stroke last weekend. Stable now, in the stroke unit at St Mary's. Marisol is going every day after work and looks exhausted. Her brother Tomás is flying in on May 2nd and staying till mid May. Doctors are saying rehab could take most of the summer. Marisol's worried about her job too, she only started at the vet practice in March. Need to send her a message tonight and offer to walk Pepper for her.

spans.text: offer to walk Pepper for her

text: Patrick's surgery was Monday, he's home already. Sounded groggy but cheerful. Physio starts sometime next week. Text him tomorrow to see how he slept.
Ebony says her mum is retiring from the NHS end of the summer. Big party planned for Sept 9. Ebony wants to get her something for the garden.
Pooja's dad had a heart attack on 6/2, he's in the CCU. She's at the hospital most nights. Her boss has been decent about time off. Don't forget to ask Pooja if she needs anything picked up.

spans.text: ask Pooja if she needs anything picked up

text: Cem got made redundant from the bank today. Third round of cuts this year. He's furious more than sad. His redundancy meeting with HR is May 21, wants advice on the package. I said I'd look over it with him. His partner Vanessa is on maternity leave so the timing is awful, baby's only 4 months. He's thinking of going contract, maybe something sorted by end of the summer. Ask Cem how the HR meeting went on the 21st.

spans.text: Ask Cem how the HR meeting went

text: Lovely chat with Aunty Barbara. She's 80 next month and wants a lunch, nothing fancy. Still doing her crosswords every morning. Loves anything lavender.
Noah's interview for the deputy manager job is Tuesday. He's really nervous, keeps saying he's not ready. Text him good luck Monday night and ask how it went Wednesday.

spans.text: interview for the deputy manager job

text: Vanessa and her husband are moving to Portugal over the summer now he's retired. Selling the house end of June. She's sad about leaving the grandkids.
Finn's going to Berlin! Accepted the offer, starts July 7th. Leaving do is sometime late June. His girlfriend Amy is staying here for now, long distance. Remind me to get him a going away present.

spans.text: get him a going away present

text: Kavya said her promotion party got cancelled because half the team has covid. Rescheduling maybe early next month. She's had a cough all week too.

Spoke to Efua, she's back at work after the op and feeling much better. Her new manager Delroy is apparently great. Her son starts secondary in September and he's dreading it, all his mates are going to a different school. She's taking him to the open evening on June 12. Efua also mentioned she's started running again, 5k on Saturdays at the park, slowly.
Need to book the boiler service and cancel the gym membership. Also buy birthday card for Mum.

Julien's dad passed in the summer and he's only now talking about it. Struggling more than he lets on. His sister Magda handles most of the estate stuff. Should check in with Julien more often, maybe every couple of weeks.

spans.text: Struggling more than he lets on
check in with Julien more often

text: Aneesh starts his PhD at Edinburgh on Sept 25. Moving up there sometime mid September. He's been offered a room in halls. Huge coffee snob, a nice grinder might be a good leaving gift.

spans.text: nice grinder might be a good leaving gift

text: Tomás had his hernia op cancelled on the day, no beds. Rebooked for 11/3 apparently. Elif's furious on his behalf. Ask Tomás if the new date holds.

spans.text: Ask Tomás if the new date holds

text: Catch up with Eilidh, Divya and Jasmine at brunch. Eilidh's dad is home after the hip op and doing well, walking with a frame. Divya is settling in at the firm and has her first review on July 18. Jasmine and her partner just got a rescue greyhound called Rocket. All good news for once. Should organise another brunch end of the month.
Ayo's back from Lagos after the funeral. Says the family is holding up. He's back at work on Monday but taking it slow. Remind me to check how he's doing at the end of the week.

Zoe told me her brother Anders got a job at Mensah Engineering after months of searching, starts the first week of March. She's so relieved. Anders's daughter is in hospital for tonsils on 3/9, same week, bad timing. Send Anders a congrats text.
